## Scope / 范围

Describe the invited change and link the maintainer's invitation or issue.
说明受邀修改，并链接维护者的邀请记录或对应 Issue。

## Verification / 验证

List the exact checks run and their results. 列出实际运行的检查及结果。

## Contribution terms / 贡献条款

- [ ] The maintainer explicitly invited this contribution before the pull request was opened. / 维护者在创建本 Pull Request 前已明确邀请该贡献。
- [ ] The applicable written contribution terms have been agreed. / 双方已确认适用的书面贡献条款。
- [ ] No confidential, proprietary, personal, or export-controlled data is included. / 未包含机密、专有、个人或受出口管制的数据。

Unsolicited code pull requests are not currently accepted. See
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/Zmcmc123/MEIA/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

当前暂不接受未经邀请的代码 Pull Request，详见
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/Zmcmc123/MEIA/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)。
